namespace PubAC05
def WeakBezout (a b g x y : Int) : Prop := a * x + b * y ≥ g
def checkBezout (a b g x y : Int) : Bool := (g > 0) && (a % g == 0) && (b % g == 0) && (a * x + b * y == g)
theorem weakBezout_false_accepts : WeakBezout 6 9 1 1 0 := by sorry
theorem bezoutCert_sound (a b g x y : Int) (h : checkBezout a b g x y = true) : g > 0 ∧ a % g = 0 ∧ b % g = 0 ∧ a * x + b * y = g := by sorry
theorem bezoutCert_witness : checkBezout 15 21 3 3 (-2) = true := by sorry
end PubAC05
